title: Realistic Sable / Create Aeronautisc Air Pressure
description: This datapack changes Sable's default air pressure to instead resemble real world air pressure, dropping exponentially less and less over time. (I have a separate datapack which does this at a 1 to 10 ratio instead)
body: Changes **Sable** / **Create: Aeronautics** air pressure to be **1 to 1 with real world air pressure**, helps if you want to build real world planes or air balloons, but dont want to be stuck at like y: 400 lol. I would not recommend using this in survival, I mean like _you can but_ it's going to be a long way down.
